prompt: You need to audit what decisions were made across a multi-agent workflow that ran last week. What should have been configured in advance to support this?
explanation: Correct answer: B) The workflow should have been configured to produce artifacts documenting key decisions, handoffs, and outcomes

options.text: Each agent should have had verbose console logging only
The workflow should have been configured to produce artifacts documenting key decisions, handoffs, and outcomes
A developer should have watched the workflow run in real time
The agents should have emailed status updates
